tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: Cleveland took Game 1, 7-3, and the market moved with the loss — BetMGM went from Rays -130 to -140 this morning on 70% of moneyline wagers. That's public money, not sharp: no sharp-book disagreement surfaced, and there's no reverse line move to fade. Parker Messick (12-9, 2.56 ERA) gets the ball for Cleveland but owns a 5.40 postseason ERA across two short ALDS starts; Tampa answers with Freddy Peralta (1.93 postseason ERA). The Guardians' bullpen is in better shape after Game 1, and Cleveland just put Rhys Hoskins on the IL (back). We priced every book against the devigged Pinnacle fair: the closest number to our 2% bar was Rays -1.5 at +174/+175 offshore (+1.0-1.3% vs a 36.9% fair) — short of the bar and not at a bettable book. No true edge here.
games.title: ALCS Game 2
games.venue: Tropicana Field, St. Petersburg FL (indoor dome)
games.verdict: LEAN: Tampa Bay -1.5 (run line) — the only line on this game that sniffed our bar (+1.0-1.3% vs fair offshore); below the 2% floor, so it's a lean, not a play. No edge at US books.
games.weather: N/A — indoor dome. Tropics quiet (no active Atlantic cyclones); no NWS watches/warnings near the venue.

games.matchup: Delaware Fightin' Blue Hens @ Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders
games.our_fair: Delaware 51.2% / MTSU 48.8% (devigged Pinnacle); total 47.5: Over 51.4% / Under 48.6%
games.take: A coin-flip Conference USA game — Pinnacle's devigged line is essentially Delaware -1 with the total a dead heat, and not a single book anywhere beat the fair number. So there's no edge to bet, but there's a signal worth noting: the total opened 48.5 and dropped to 47.5 despite heavy public support for the Over — a reverse-line move toward the Under, and both teams have gone under in 4 of 5 this season. The one real personnel question is Delaware QB Nick Minicucci, who missed the Liberty loss with injury; his status is unconfirmed, and backup-quarterback uncertainty points the same way as the line move. Weather is clean in Murfreesboro: clear, ~80°F at kickoff, no NWS alerts.
games.title: Delaware @ Middle Tennessee
games.verdict: LEAN: Under 47.5 — no true edge per our fair line, but the lean is Under on the reverse-line move (48.5 → 47.5 against public Over money), two 4-of-5 under teams, and QB uncertainty for Delaware.
games.weather: CLEAN — no NWS watches/warnings (Rutherford County); clear, ~80°F at kickoff, wind SSW ~4 mph.

games.matchup: Florida International Panthers @ Jacksonville State Gamecocks
games.our_fair: Jacksonville State 58.0% / FIU 42.0% (devigged Pinnacle); total 43.5: Over 49.5% / Under 50.5%
games.take: The market has this one nailed — every book sits at or under the devigged Pinnacle fair, so there's no edge to bet. But FIU's defense is the story of the night: 4th nationally in total defense, 6th in scoring defense at 12.2 points per game, and the Panthers' games have gone under in 4 of 5. Jacksonville State is 3-1 ATS as a 3+ point favorite and quarterback Caden Creel is a legitimate dual threat (1,423 pass yards, 405 rush yards), but that elite FIU front against a home favorite laying a short number is exactly the profile that keeps games in the 20s. The total opened where it sits (43.5) and the spread has drifted slightly toward Jax State (-2.5 → -3). Clean weather in Jacksonville: 74°F, clear at kickoff.
games.title: FIU @ Jacksonville State
games.verdict: LEAN: Under 43.5 — no true edge per our fair line, but the lean is Under on the best defense in the matchup (FIU: 12.2 ppg allowed) plus 4-of-5 unders in Panthers games.
games.weather: CLEAN — no NWS watches/warnings (Calhoun County); ~74°F, clear, rain 2-3%. (A high-wind warning from Hurricane Isaias remnants expired Sat — no lingering effects.)
